summariesJSON.title: CHAPTER 1: THE WATER CYCLE
summariesJSON.content: Chapter 1 explains the water cycle, which encompasses the ongoing movement of water on, above, and below the Earth's surface. It details the key stages: Evaporation, where water transforms into vapor; Condensation, where vapor cools to form clouds; Precipitation, which involves water returning to the Earth as rain, snow, or hail; and Collection, where water gathers in bodies of water and underground.

summariesJSON.title: Document summary
summariesJSON.content: This document provides a comprehensive overview of the water cycle. It elaborates on its continuous movement across Earth's surface and the atmosphere.
